meaning: A big, loud portable radio and tape player with built-in speakers, carried by a handle or on a shoulder.
clues: A big portable music player made so everyone nearby could hear.
It had a radio, a place for tapes, and two big speakers.
It ran on lots of batteries and was heavy to carry.
It was very popular in the 1980s, and people carried it on their shoulders.
It has two words. The first sounds like a loud bang and the second is a container.
assumes: A jukebox sits in one place and plays songs for coins
A transistor radio is small and plays radio only
A personal cassette player is for one listener with headphones

decoys.meaning: A machine that stays in one place and plays the song you pick after you put in coins.
A small battery radio that plays radio stations only.
A small tape player with headphones, so only the listener hears the music.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Now that was a way to make an entrance. A bunch of batteries, and the whole block heard your song.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: a small portable speaker that plays music from your phone. Tip: keep the volume polite in public.
